name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
overview: Kim Milyoner Olmak İster? (English: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?), is the fourth Turkish version based off the British game show Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?. The show aired from August 2, 2011 on aTV. Previously hosted by Kenan Işık, Selçuk Yöntem, Murat Yıldırım, and Kenan İmirzalıoğlu, it is currently presented by Oktay Kaynarca. The top prize is 5.000.000 new Turkish liras.
